review_findings.candidate_lemma_proof: Interior rect rows brow+1..brow+tall-2 are flanked at bcol-1 and bcol+wide by the blob's own first side-roof layer; those cells were checked free of 4/8 in output when drawn (input-8 implies output-8 at all times), the other rect cannot reach them (spacing 5), and the other blob's caps are rejected on 4. So interior rows are exact maximal runs. Rows brow-1/brow+tall (own cap layer 0, width wide-2) cannot be an exact [bcol,bcol+wide-1] run because the other blob contributes at most one contiguous segment per row and covering both ends would collide with the cap. Hence the block of identical exact runs is interior rows plus optionally the two corner rows, and ra0 in {i0-1,i0}, ra1 in {i1,i1+1} always contains the truth. Empirically confirmed by brute over all sub-rectangles (corner-contact witnesses in test_review_v6).
